title: 3 Day Amboseli Fly-in Safari
rank_math_title: Amboseli Fly-in Safari: 3 Stunning Days Below Kilimanjaro
rank_math_desc: Amboseli fly-in safari for 3 days: a short flight from Nairobi to Amboseli, elephants below Kilimanjaro and two nights at Ol Tukai Lodge. Price on request.
post_content: This Amboseli fly-in safari takes you from Nairobi to the foot of Kilimanjaro in under an hour for big elephant herds and mountain views.
overview:
This Amboseli fly-in safari is a short, scenic escape from Nairobi. The flight takes under an hour, and on a clear day Kilimanjaro fills the window as you land.

Amboseli is famous for large elephant families, many with long tusks, walking across the plains in front of the mountain.

Why choose this Amboseli fly-in safari?

  • Quick and easy: skip the four to five hour drive.
  • Kilimanjaro views: best at sunrise and sometimes again at sunset.
  • Elephants: some of the best elephant viewing in Africa.
  • Observation Hill: a short climb for views over the swamps.

Where you stay

Two nights at Ol Tukai Lodge, or similar, in the heart of the park.

Best time for a Amboseli fly-in safari

June to October and January to February are the driest months, with the best chance of clear mountain views. The rainy months bring green grass and fewer visitors.

Combine it with the Mara on our Masai Mara and Amboseli fly-in safari, or browse all flight packages. Park details are on the Kenya Wildlife Service website.

How much does the Amboseli fly-in safari cost?

Price on request. The cost depends on your travel dates, group size, the season and the lodges you choose, so we prepare every quote personally rather than showing one fixed price.

faq.q: How long is the flight to Amboseli?
faq.a: Under an hour from Wilson Airport.

faq.q: How much luggage can I bring?
faq.a: Light aircraft usually allow 15 kg per person, including hand luggage, in soft bags without wheels. Ask us if you need extra space.

faq.q: Will I see Kilimanjaro on the Amboseli fly-in safari?
faq.a: Very likely in the early morning. Clouds often cover the mountain later in the day.

faq.q: Is Amboseli good for big cats?
faq.a: Lions and cheetahs live there, but elephants are the main attraction.

faq.q: Can I fly to Amboseli from the coast?
faq.a: Yes. See our Diani to Amboseli and Masai Mara fly-in safari.
